correctness.rationale: For all even m,n>=4, the F2 torus adjacency factors into (1+XY)(1+XY^-1). Both diagonal orbit kernels have dimension gcd(m,n), and the even intersections prove ker P is contained in im Q; hence nullity is 2g. Bipartite block form yields cut rank mn/2-g. The Schmidt spectrum is flat by character orthogonality. Every vertex has even degree, and the explicit all-ones/rank-one argument proves the universal +1 edge deletion. The standalone finite checker passed 64 size cases and 703 edge cases; the analytic proof supplies the infinite quantifiers.
